description: Say you are reverse engineering or documenting a format, so nobody duplicates the work: adds a claim (who, contact, scope, up to 90 days) to data/formats/<id>.yaml, creating the record if the format is new. Call lookup_format first.

category.description: Required only for a new format

contact.description: How others reach the claimant: email, GitHub handle, issue URL

extensions.description: Extensions of a new format, without the dot

force_new.description: Create a new record even though a similar format exists

id.description: Format id if it exists (from identify_file, lookup_format or search_formats). Otherwise give name + category.

name.description: Format name, for a format not in OpenFormatDB yet

scope.description: What you will document, e.g. "header and index", "full read support"

who.description: Who is working on it: your human's name or handle

name: claim_format
title: Claim a format
